whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Nirvana The Fine Dine,

I noticed your restaurant has phenomenal 4.1★ reviews across 5,200+ customers on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile web page for table reservations and direct menu orders.

Maine aapke fine dine restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/nirvana

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Nirvana The Fine Dine, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, digital menu showcase, and your prime Boring Road location highlights. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
